Using the reflection's correction:

\[
e^{i1990\pi/3}=e^{i(663\pi+\pi/3)}=e^{i663\pi}e^{i\pi/3}=(-1)e^{i\pi/3}
\]

and similarly

\[
e^{-i1990\pi/3}=(-1)e^{-i\pi/3}.
\]

Thus

\[
\left(\frac{x}{x+y}\right)^{1990}+\left(\frac{y}{x+y}\right)^{1990}
= -e^{i\pi/3}-e^{-i\pi/3}
= -2\cos\frac{\pi}{3}
= -1.
\]

\[
\boxed{-1}
\]
